about: Whitehorse is the capital and largest community of Yukon, on the Yukon River in a broad mountain valley. It is the territory’s government, transport, and service hub, with a compact downtown above the river and neighbourhoods climbing the surrounding benches. Wilderness trails start minutes from city streets. About 28,000 people live in Whitehorse.
